title: Marchland Oaths 1.6.1 rendered gallery review
edition_note: 1.6.1 changes one surface: the legacy save import confirmation. The 1.6.0 set in docs/galleries/1.6.0/ remains the visual record of every other screen; nothing else was re-captured because no other pixels changed.
method: Every frame inspected at native size in both locales and both viewports after the final capture; automated design-token, icon-provenance and copy contracts run separately.
defects_found_and_fixed_before_acceptanc: Codex tabs showed raw node names instead of localized category titles
Codex close button had an icon and no readable label
Settlement happiness and health used the danger fill at healthy values
Diplomacy faction list clipped two of the eight factions
staged_state: Statistics rows, the credits NG+ banner, the tier 4 settlement and the finale composition are labelled QA fixtures in the acceptance document; they are not presented as a fresh save.
scope: Readable controls, no clipping or missing glyphs in the reviewed frames. Stylized presentation; no photorealism or AAA claim. Human playtesting stays an owner check in HANDOFF.md.
